label: prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights
title: Closed-form Jones/Temperley–Lieb weights on $H_3(q)$ (Borromean Jones polynomial): $y_{(3)} = [4]_q/[2]_q^3$, $y_{(2,1)} = 1/[2]_q^2$, $y_{(1^3)} = 0$
html:
Proposition. Closed-form Jones/Temperley–Lieb weights on H_3(q) (Borromean Jones polynomial): y_{(3)} = [4]_q/[2]_q^3, y_{(2,1)} = 1/[2]_q^2, y_{(1^3)} = 0

Let y_\lambda(q) denote the coefficient of \chi^\lambda in the Frobenius expansion \mathrm{tr}_M^{\mathrm{Jones}} = \sum_{\lambda \vdash 3} y_\lambda \, \chi^\lambda of the Jones-normalised Markov trace on \mathrm{H}_3(q) — the V_{\mathrm{Jones}} / [2]_q^{\,c-1} Temperley–Lieb closure of prop:borromean-markov-trace-closed-form, i.e. the trace computing the Borromean rings' Jones polynomial. (This is not the full-Hecke Ocneanu trace consumed by the mass/binding pipeline — see the Scope note below.) Then for all q:

  \boxed{\;\;
  y_{(3)}(q) \;=\; \frac{[4]_q}{[2]_q^{3}},
  \qquad
  y_{(2,1)}(q) \;=\; \frac{1}{[2]_q^{2}},
  \qquad
  y_{(1^3)}(q) \;=\; 0.
  \;\;}

At the symmetric point q = 1 these evaluate to

  \bigl(y_{(3)},\, y_{(2,1)},\, y_{(1^3)}\bigr)\big|_{q=1}
  \;=\;
  \bigl(\tfrac{1}{2},\, \tfrac{1}{4},\, 0\bigr)
  \qquad \text{— \emph{not} uniform.}

The scope of this trace normalisation, the immediate Borromean corollary, the chirality of the weights, the notation distinctions, and the significance for the Borromean derivation are collected in the Wenzl-weights context.

What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall: it invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs — real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0.
